build_phonon_data_list: build a list of phonon yaml file paths from an index dataframe using get_mdr_phonon_data_list
create_MDRPhononRunner: create an MDRPhononRunner instance with an ASE calculator and displacement value for phonon calculations
run_MDRPhononRunner_calculate: run phonon calculations on a chunk of phonon yaml files and return frequency and thermodynamic results
write_MDRPhononRunner_results: write phonon calculation results to a compressed json file using write_results
save_MDRPhononRunner_state: save the MDRPhononRunner checkpoint state to a specified location using save_state
